title: Project-script buttons for the atm project

revisions.summary: First draft from the setup request

weakest.why: worktree URL mismatch has no settled fix

questions.question: How should previewUrls map onto worktree folders, where pages land under the worktree name?
options: Symlink ~/.claude/pr-previews/atm to the checkout that ran last
questions.why: The URL is fixed per button but the page folder is named after the checkout

assumptions.text: Buttons run in the thread's checkout, not the project root.
T3 Code will eventually fix project-script writes (pingdotgg/t3code#14991).

scope.text: LAN or NetBird exposure of port 8765

acceptance.text: Spec progress, Preview PR, Deploy status and Ship pre-flight each exist in the atm project's scripts menu.
Each command runs under env -i with PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin without "command not found".
lsof shows port 8765 listening on 127.0.0.1 only, and the Mac's LAN address refuses the connection.
Each button's previewUrl returns HTTP 200 after the button has run in the same checkout.
Preview PR and Ship produce screenshots, not "screenshots failed".
Spec progress renders a page for this spec.

risks.text: Port 8765 exposed by a stray default bind
risks.mitigation: PR_PREVIEW_BIND=127.0.0.1 in every command; check with lsof

risks.text: Stale pages mistaken for fresh ones
risks.mitigation: Open the page from the checkout that ran it; check its timestamp
